[[We Go|We Go (English Ver.)]] (Asia) | ja_op=[[Halo|ハロ]] | ja_ed=[[RVR ~Rising Volt Tacklers Rap~|RVR〜ライジングボルテッカーズラップ〜[オリオVer.PART2]]] | olmteam=Team Kato | scenarion=1 | scenario=永川成基 | storyboardn=1 | storyboard=矢嶋哲生 | directorn=1 | director=岩田義彦 | artn=5 | art=柳原好貴 | art2=大西雅也 | art3=山縣クリカ | art4=高星佑平 | art5=倉員千晶 | morecredits=yes | epstaffpage=HZ031-HZ040 | footnotes=* {{BMGf|299758|Preview thread on BMGf}} ''Closed'' * {{BMGf|299935|Original review thread on BMGf}} * {{BMGf|302547|Dub review thread on BMGf}} }} '''Respective Departures''' (Japanese: '''それぞれの旅立ち''' ''Respective Departures'') is the 34th episode of ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]'', and the 1,266th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on December 22, 2023, in the United Kingdom on July 22, 2024, and in the United States on August 9, 2024. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== After overhearing Diana tell Friede that she plans to set off on her own, Liko and Roy decide to throw her a surprise going-away party. Dot even has a special video planned for the occasion. Meanwhile, at the Explorers’ headquarters, Amethio asks Hamber for help getting stronger. The two have a heated battle, with Amethio giving his all, but Ceruledge is defeated after Hamber Terastallizes his Dusknoir. Hamber later gives Amethio his own Tera Orb, and Amethio vows to learn how to use it to its full potential. Back on the Brave Olivine, the party has ended, and Diana departs… As for the Rising Volt Tacklers? Next stop, Paldea! ==Plot== Picking up from before, [[Liko]] is glad {{an|Terapagos}} is awake and doing okay. [[Diana]], watching from the window, is glad too. Later, [[Friede]] enters the observation deck to check on Diana, who is packing up for her departure. She asks Friede to look after Terapagos for her. Friede has decided to head back to [[Paldea]] seeing how there have been ancient records of Terapagos sightings there and that the {{pkmn|category|Tera Pokémon}} is linked to the [[Terastal phenomenon]]. With that, Diana asks Friede to drop her off at the next port. Liko and [[Roy]] are eavesdropping from outside, and ask {{TP|Roy|Wattrel}} and {{DL|Diana|Squawkabilly}} to be silent so as to not blow their cover. Roy asks Liko if she will miss her grandmother, and Liko doesn't let it get to her knowing that's how Diana has always been. Roy then proposes a farewell party for Diana, and they decide to get the people and Pokémon on the [[Brave Olivine]] to help out. Finishing up one of her Nidothing videos, [[Dot]] gets a call from {{an|Iono}}. Iono thanks Dot for the Terastal Cap promotion deal, since she couldn't take it herself as can't put it on with her headgear. Iono brings up Dot being a Trainer now, but Dot says that she already knew about the {{pkmn|Trainer}} stuff before she actually became one. Just then, Liko and Roy knock on the door. {{TP|Roy|Fuecoco}} comes running in through the hatch on the door, alarming Dot. Liko tells her about their plans for a party. Dot doesn't follow, but Iono understands that her IRL friends want her to come. Liko thanks Iono for the other day, and the latter asks for a favor back. She wants Liko to look after Dot, flustering her. Iono continues about Dot's new trainer status. Looking at Liko and Roy, Dot ends her call with Iono, saying that she doesn't like parties. At the [[Explorers]] base, [[Amethio]] consults [[Gibeon]], saying that while he was able to reach {{FB|Black|Rayquaza}}, he was no match for it. Gibeon asks Amethio how he felt when engaging the Sky High Pokémon. Amethio says that it wasn't taking the battle seriously, more like it was testing him. Amethio says that he will seize Rayquaza next time, and Gibeon agrees knowing that it and Terapagos are the essential keys to Laqua, "his" paradise. After the meeting concludes, Amethio requests {{pkmn|training}} from [[Hamber]]. The battle takes place, with Amethio using his {{TP|Amethio|Ceruledge}} and Hamber using his {{DL|Hamber|Dusknoir}}. Ceruledge starts with {{m|Psycho Cut}}, which Dusknoir counters with {{m|Shadow Ball}}. Using the smoke to its advantage, Ceruledge goes behind Dusknoir and prepares to use {{m|Night Slash}}, only for Dusknoir to notice and land a Shadow Punch on the Fire Blades Pokémon. Activating its {{a|Weak Armor}} [[Ability]], Ceruledge tries to use {{m|Bitter Blade}}, but Dusknoir catches it by its arms and hits it with Shadow Ball. In its launch, Ceruledge uses {{m|Phantom Force}}. However, Dusknoir grabs it from the portal and throws it aside. Ceruledge cuts through Dusknoir's following Shadow Ball. Amethio believes that Dusknoir has no blind spots. Hamber asks him if he will concede, but a determined Amethio commands Ceruledge to use Psycho Cut, which slices through Dusknoir's consecutive Shadow Ball attacks. The Gripper Pokémon follows up with {{m|Shadow Punch}} while Ceruledge tries to keep it at a distance using Psycho Cut. Hamber has Dusknoir close the gap, but Ceruledge wraps its arms and legs around Dusknoir's arm, which disrupts its attack. This surprises Hamber, who knows that Amethio isn't used to this battling style. When Dusknoir shakes Ceruledge off, the Fire Blades Pokémon uses Phantom Force, sneaking behind Dusknoir and knocking it to the ground. Hamber is impressed by Amethio, who indeed desires strength. Deciding not to hold back anymore, Hamber pulls out a [[Tera Orb]] and Terastallizes Dusknoir into a Ghost Tera Type, commanding a powered-up Shadow Ball. Ceruledge uses Bitter Blade to cut through it but is caught off guard by Dusknoir, who knocks it out with its following Shadow Punch. Hamber asks Amethio if he is satisfied, but he requests a [[rematch]]. Back on the ship, Diana watches the sunset before {{DL|Diana|Arcanine}} points her to the meeting room. Diana opens the door and everyone surprises her with a party they all put together for her. As the Pokémon start singing together, [[Murdock]] brings out a cake for Diana, having {{TP|Murdock|Alcremie}} use its cream to decorate it before topping it with berries. Diana also gets some tea for everyone to have with the cake. As they eat together, Friede ends up accidentally getting a sip of {{p|Sinistea}}'s tea. Murdock teases Friede about not telling the teacups apart from the Black Tea Pokémon before collapsing when he accidentally drinks some of {{p|Polteageist}}'s tea despite Friede's warning, so Diana has Arcanine carrying him off to bed. Dot then presents a video that she made about all the good times Diana had with the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]. First, the film shows their escape from the old castle from the Explorers, then the Rising Volt Tacklers enjoying [[curry]] in the [[Wild Area]], and [[HZ028|the trouble they got into]] with [[Tepen]] at his antique shop, which [[Ludlow]] tries and fails to make a joke out of. Finally, the film ends with Liko and Roy's training battle against Diana, ending with Liko thanking her grandmother. The video gets a positive response from Diana, the kids revealing that three of them made it together, though Dot did most of the work. Diana thanks everyone for the party. Hamber complements Amethio's growing strength, but Amethio knows he needs to be a lot stronger if he wants to be a match for Rayquaza. Seeing how far that wish will take him, Hamber gives Amethio a Tera Orb for himself. Amethio acknowledges that by mastering Terastallization, he will get the power he needs to rival Rayquaza. As [[Spinel]]'s {{p|Beheeyem}} spies on them, he and [[Chalce]] decide to let them have their moment. With collected data on Terapagos's resonance reaction, they plan to go after Rayquaza. Liko enters the kitchen and helps Diana with the dishes. Liko then thanks her grandmother for giving her the pendant. It was just like she said, that taking the first step was the scariest part. By doing just that, Liko was able to find new horizons with each passing moment. Finding the confidence to speak her mind without holding back, and facing each danger that followed with courage and friends by her side. Diana takes Liko to the observation deck, feeling like she should be the one thanking her for reigniting her yearning for adventure. She gives Liko her adventure log, having decided to set off on new adventures. Likewise, Liko gives her grandmother a gift in return, a bracelet that she made herself thanks to [[Ann]] teaching her how to do it. After the ship drops off Diana at the port, the Rising Volt Tacklers are on a course for Paldea. They make finding the rest of the [[Six Heroes]] their top priority so that Terapagos can regain its power and the way to Laqua can open. ==Major events== * The [[Explorers]] are revealed to be looking for [[Laqua]]. * [[Amethio]] receives a [[Tera Orb]] from [[Hamber]]. * [[Diana]] leaves the [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]. * The Rising Volt Tacklers decide to return to [[Paldea]]. {{animeevents|HZ}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * [[Liko]] * [[Roy]] * [[Friede]] * [[Mollie]] * [[Orla]] * [[Ludlow]] * [[Murdock]] * [[Dot]] * [[Diana]] * {{an|Iono}} (video) * [[Amethio]] * [[Hamber]] * [[Spinel]] * [[Chalce]] * [[Gibeon]] (voice) * [[Alex]] (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Sprigatito}} ({{OP|Liko|Sprigatito}}) * {{p|Hatenna}} ({{OP|Liko|Hatenna}}) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Liko]]'s;
